post.description: Create anonymous draft or reuse the valid current cookie. Successful authorized activity renews a seven-day idle deadline; failures never renew it. MP_INTAKE is HttpOnly and stores an opaque secret only.

put.description: Only the selected page keys may be present. Partial matrix/ranking drafts are allowed. expectedRevision is mandatory CAS; conflict uses error.details.currentRevision. Successful writes increment revision.

post.description: Validate ten required pages and freeze 13 normalized answers. Q12 skipped channel becomes DECLINED. Immutable profile and recommendation are created atomically; sourceDraftRevision uniqueness also prevents duplicates across new idempotency keys. Public recommendation precedes registration.

post.description: Requires a submitted, unexpired, unclaimed intake and accepted TERMS/PRIVACY v1. Atomically claims all profile versions, recommendations and events before email verification. Claimed cookie is revoked; retries use safe recovery/login, not anonymous read restoration. Research consent is optional.

visibleDurationMs.description: Client-reported continuous visibility after core content rendered. Validates the observation only; it is not trusted proof of attention and is not stored as a business fact.

Origin.name: Origin
Origin.description: Local P1 exact-origin allowlist; deployment is a separate gate.

Error.description: Safe error. Common statuses: 400 malformed input, 401 missing/expired actor, 403 CSRF/origin or verification, 404 concealed cross-owner resource, 409 revision/version/claim/idempotency conflict, 422 questionnaire invalid, 429 bounded rate limit, 503 security dependency unavailable. Only revision conflict includes details.currentRevision.

IntakeSession.name: MP_INTAKE
IntakeSession.description: Opaque secret, HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax; public API path only. Seven-day inactivity.

StudentSession.name: MP_SESSION
StudentSession.description: Opaque HttpOnly cookie scoped /api/app/v1; does not accept RuoYi administrator JWT.

CsrfHeader.name: X-CSRF-Token
CsrfHeader.description: Signed, actor-bound token matching readable MP_PUBLIC_CSRF or MP_CSRF cookie; exact local Origin required on writes.
